newsitem.title: CHINA: China airline names plane 'Return of Hong Kong'.
newsitem.headline: China airline names plane 'Return of Hong Kong'.

text.p: A Chinese airline has named one of its new passenger planes "Return of Hong Kong" to commemorate the return of the former British colony to Chinese rule on July 1, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Monday.
The Airbus A320 was turned over to its owner -- Southern Airlines -- last week, shortly after the handover of Hong Kong.
Airbus painted the new plane free of charge and held a special joint delivery and handover celebration, it said.
The plane would be used by Southern Airlines on routes between the southern city of Guangzhou and the southwestern cities of Guilin and Kunming, it said.
